config.ablation: remove only comparison-level plan permission, retaining local validity, exact slot coverage and scientific-key binding
expected_claims: comparison-level permission is a distinct obligation even for locally valid, scientifically identical evidence
case counts validate declared obligations and do not estimate operational fault prevalence
revision savings depend on the declared invalidation footprint
config.gap_analysis: initial and fresh revised panels; exact largest minus second-largest candidate mean, retaining ties
config.label: post-registration reviewer-requested artifact-level validation
config.permission_control: the identical panel with both original plans permitted
config.permission_negative: retain only the initial plan in D; replace replicate zero of each candidate with its existing locally valid remap object
config.revision_footprints: analytical consequences of the implemented monolithic key, not new trajectory experiments
config.sampling: all 32 existing design sessions; no new simulation or seed

timing.boundary: decide on all initial panels with cached verified tokens; excludes store verification, replay and file I/O
